newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Tender result for big Kazakh oil producer seen Friday.
newsitem.headline: Tender result for big Kazakh oil producer seen Friday.

text.p: The result of a tender for a 50 to 60 percent stake in Kazakhstan's largest oil producer, Mangistaumunaigaz, could be known at the end of this week, a senior Kazakh privatisation official said on Monday.

"The situation with the Mangistaumunaigaz tender should be clear on Friday," a senior official at Kazakhstan's State Privatisation Committee, who declined to be named, told Reuters in the Kazakh capital Almaty.

Oryx Energy Co and K & B of the United States, Vitol-Kazakhstan (a joint venture with Dutch oil trader and refiner Vitol), Central Asia Petroleum Ltd of Indonesia's Setdco Group, Neft S.A. of Russia and ZAO Mangistaumunaigaz have all submitted bids.
Official privatisation sources said last week that K & B or Central Asia Petroleum were in the running to win.

The troubled crude oil producer, located near Kazakhstan's Caspian Sea coast, accounts for about one third of Kazakh oil production and produced six million tonnes of oil (120,000 barrels per day) and 1.8 billion cubic metres of gas in 1995.
